title: Every sentence is supported
question: What payload and battery runtime does the HX-2 have?
answer: The HX-2 has a payload of 60 kg [P1]. Its battery gives a runtime of 8 hours [P1]. The battery pack is the HX2-BAT-48V [P1].

title: A wrong number and a wrong citation
question: Compare the payload and battery runtime of the HX-2 and the older HX-1.
answer: The HX-2 has a payload of 60 kg [P1]. The HX-2 can carry a payload of 80 kg [P1]. The older HX-1 runs for 5 hours per charge [P1].

title: True but without a citation
question: How long does the HX-2 battery last and how fast does it charge?
answer: The HX-2 battery gives a runtime of 8 hours [P1]. Fast charging from 20 to 80 percent takes 45 minutes.
